label: Checklist Toggles
description: A feature as rows that switch ON as the voice names them: white pill cards (icon, label, switch) sliding into a stack, each switch flipping to the accent color at its own word anchor. Three to five rows; one line of type above or beside it names the feature. The launch-film feature beat (naano). Position and size it with the component's box; rows size themselves to it.

items.label: Rows, in order: [{icon: an emoji or short glyph, label: the row's words (2-5), at: scene seconds when its switch flips (a word anchor), on: false to leave it off}]

at.label: When the first row enters (scene seconds; default 0.4)

flip_delay.label: Seconds after the last row lands before the first switch flips, when rows carry no at (default 0.5)

interval.label: Seconds between switches flipping, when rows carry no at (default 0.55)

color.label: The ON color of the switch (default brand success green)

theme.label: light (white cards, default) | dark (charcoal cards for a dark ground)

hold.label: Seconds before the stack exits (0/omit = stays)

scale.label: Size multiplier for the whole prop
